zh.title: 上市前市场分析：挂牌之前要看清什么
zh.seo_title: 卖房上市前市场分析指南｜陈靖
zh.description: 上市前市场分析不只是定一个价格，还要看竞争房源、库存变化、买方需求和你的时间表。本文说明要看哪些数据、怎么解读、常见误区，以及如何据此决定上市时机和价格策略。
zh.lead: 定价之前，先看清你的房子上市时会和谁竞争、买方会拿什么来比较。这一步决定后面的准备和时间表。

en.title: Pre-Listing Market Analysis: What to Check First
en.seo_title: Pre-Listing Market Analysis for Sellers | Jing Chen
en.description: Before you list, check active competition, recent sales, inventory and your own timeline. Here is what to look at and how to turn it into a pricing plan.
en.lead: Before settling on a price, look at what your home will compete against and how buyers will compare it. That shapes your preparation and timing.
